# GitLab Duo Formatter

<!-- Auto-generated by `pnpm docs:formatters`. Do not edit manually. -->

PromptScript compiles your `.prs` sources to native GitLab Duo configuration. The main output is `AGENTS.md`. It is not enabled by default, add it to `targets` to use it.

## Enable the Target

```yaml
targets:
  - gitlab-duo
```

Pick an output version when you need more than the default:

```yaml
targets:
  - gitlab-duo:
      version: full
```

## Overview

| Property        | Value                          |
| --------------- | ------------------------------ |
| **Tier**        | Tier 3                         |
| **Main output** | `AGENTS.md`                    |
| **Skills**      | Yes (`skills/<name>/SKILL.md`) |
| **Agents**      | No                             |
| **Commands**    | No                             |
| **Local files** | No                             |

## Output Files

| File              | Path                     | Purpose                    |
| ----------------- | ------------------------ | -------------------------- |
| Main instructions | `AGENTS.md`              | Primary rule file          |
| Skills            | `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` | Reusable skill definitions |

## Output Versions

| Version          | Output                                       |
| ---------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `simple`         | Single AGENTS.md file                        |
| `multifile`      | Single AGENTS.md file (skills via full mode) |
| `full` (default) | Multifile + skills/<name>/SKILL.md           |

## MCP and Hooks

| Block         | Support       |
| ------------- | ------------- |
| `@mcpServers` | Not supported |
| `@hooks`      | Not supported |

Native hook reference: <https://promptscript.dev/docs/guides/hooks/>
